description: List Google Drive files matching a Drive search query (for example "name contains 'budget' and mimeType='application/pdf'"), newest first. Returns id, name, mime type, modified time, and size per file. Defaults to 500 files to avoid exhausting rate limits and pulling more than needed. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 1000, Drive's own real single-call maximum, Google, current as of this writing) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above the cap is refused rather than silently clamped. Requires a connected account (run connect_account first).
embedding_description: Search the connected Google Drive and return matching file descriptors using Drive's own search grammar - name contains, mimeType, modifiedTime, trashed, parents in a folder. Returns each file's id, name, mime type, modified time, size, newest first, defaulting to 500 files (raise to 1000 -- Drive's own single-call max -- via acknowledge_default_limit_override + row_limit).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a files list ({id, name, mime, modified, size}) and a count.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize how many files matched and list a few by name. Suggest drive_download_file with an id to fetch a binary file. File names may reveal content — treat as moderately sensitive.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List Google Drive files matching a search query.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.auth_expired: the refresh token was revoked. gsuite.rate_limited: Google throttled the request.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_connected / gsuite.auth_expired: run connect_account. gsuite.rate_limited: back off and retry.
